title: Gifts
text:
Your presence is the gift. If you’d still like to give something, here are the two ways to do that. They support different things, so we’ve kept them separate.


Honeymoon Fund
We’re skipping a traditional registry. If you’d like to contribute toward our honeymoon, this goes directly toward the trip.

text:
We can’t wait to celebrate with our favorite people for a few days of good food and good company among the gorgeous Northern Arizona pines.
Everything you need is here: schedule, lodging, and RSVPing. Need help with anything? Please reach out!

title: Tatum & Tavian
text:
The short version

When: Friday–Saturday, May 7th & 8th, 2027
Where: The Legacy Lodge, Heber, Arizona
Dress code: Something nice for the reception and something comfy for rehashing the next day! For our non-Arizona friends, bring layers as the mountains can get chilly in the evenings.
Questions: TheRobeyWatsons@gmail.com
